== Biography ==
Jannet was born in 1640. She is the daughter of [[Glasgow-1103|Thomas Glasgow]]

== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-1103]] is assessed at 74% (probable). Jannet’s 29 November 1640 Linlithgow baptism explicitly names father Thomas. Thomas-1103, born in 1612 and associated with the Inveresk Thomas/Agnes Thomson family in 1634–43, has a feasible age and Lothian setting.

Probable identification of the named Thomas with the selected adult; the baptism names no mother and does not independently bridge the parish households.

Next useful test: Find a marriage, tenancy or sibling entry linking the Linlithgow and Inveresk Thomas.

Source basis already held: [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=SCOT%2FOPR%2FBAP%2F0497603&tab=this Findmypast, Scotland, Parish Births & Baptisms 1564-1929: Jannet Glasgow, 1640, record SCOT/OPR/BAP/0497603]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.


A possible identification concerns Joannet Glasgow. The banns/marriage index records Joannet Glasgow and Andrew Allexander/ on 8 August 1661 at Glasgow.<ref>Scotland’s People: Old Parish Registers — banns and marriages: OPR 644 / 1/230 / 230; [https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk/ record].</ref> The original parish register image has not been inspected. The combined index date does not by itself identify the precise event type. The identification remains uncertain.

A possible identification concerns Janet Glasgow. The death/burial index records Janet Glasgow on 25 December 1675 at Polwarth. Other-details field: Tod / William Glasgow.<ref>Scotland’s People: Old Parish Registers — deaths and burials: OPR 754/10 / 113; [https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk/ record].</ref> The original parish register image has not been inspected. The combined index date does not by itself identify the precise event type. The index may identify Janet Tod and a spouse or associate William Glasgow. Tod as birth surname and the relationship to William require the original. This does not identify William as the father of the 1656/1658 Polwarth children. The identification remains uncertain.
